“`

Breaking through the tenth rank, for Lin Yuan, besides the most direct aspect of a dramatic increase in strength.

There was another benefit, that being the perception of rules became much easier.

The heights at which the ninth rank and the tenth rank stood were different, and the scenery they observed naturally differed as well.

Lin Yuan’s Against-Heaven’s Understanding was the same, when at the ninth rank, perceiving the fusion of pillar-level rules felt obscure and difficult to comprehend.

But at the tenth rank?

...

It couldn’t be said to be easy, but it likewise couldn’t be described as obscure.

Having stepped into the tenth rank for several years, Lin Yuan first gained a deep perception of the fusion between the life rule and the death rule, these two kinds of pillar-level rules.

At this moment, all of the perceptions transformed into inspiration, propelling Lin Yuan to make that final step.

[You possess Against-Heaven’s Understanding, perceiving the life rule and the death rule, beginning the fusion of rules…]

…

[You possess Against-Heaven’s Understanding, perceiving the life rule and the death rule, beginning the fusion of rules…]

…

[You possess Against-Heaven’s Understanding, perceiving the life rule and the death rule, successfully completing the fusion smoothly…]

…

Boom.

A rumble exploded in Lin Yuan’s mind, as the life rule and the death rule completely fused, forming a completely new rule power.

This type of rule power encompassed both life and death, causing the two to continually reincarnate, as if there was no end at all.

“I’ve finally… comprehended a pillar-level fusion rule…”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

Normally speaking, a tenth rank evolver who comprehends a pillar-level fusion rule, which is at least the new rule formed after the fusion of two pillar-level rules, would then be able to rank among the Grade A of the tenth rank.

However, this step for tenth rank evolvers took a very, very long time.

It’s just that Lin Yuan… firstly, Lin Yuan’s foundation was too robust, having thoroughly perceived all the major pillar-level rules even before stepping into the tenth rank.

Secondly, Lin Yuan possessed an Against-Heaven’s Understanding.

Other tenth rank evolvers, when they first enter this level, haven’t even fully comprehended a few pillar-level rules, let alone developed a pillar-level fusion rule.

The two weren’t even on the same level.

“Fusing the life rule and the death rule, the fusion rule I’ve comprehended should be the Life and Death Samsara Rule?” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

The Life and Death Samsara Rule, among many pillar-level rules, is a very powerful fusion rule, encompassing the two pillar rules of life and death, which are completely extreme and opposite rules.

The difficulty of fusing the life rule with the death rule exceeds the fusion of other pillar-level rules, but once successful, the might of the formed Life and Death Samsara Rule is extraordinarily formidable.

“With my current strength, under normal circumstances, should I be able to reach the threshold of eleventh rank now?” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

For a regular tenth rank powerhouse, comprehending one kind of pillar-level fusion rule completely transforms their own strength.

Different types of pillar-level fusion rules exist, with various focal points, but no matter which kind of pillar-level fusion rule, all can enable a tenth rank powerhouse to jump straight into the Grade A threat list.

So—

After Lin Yuan comprehended the Life and Death Samsara Rule, his own strength likewise welcomed a significant increase.

To put it simply.

If the pillar-level fusion rule is compared to a sharp blade.

In the hands of ordinary people, it can cause tremendous lethality, and in the hands of evolvers, the lethality will be even stronger and higher.

The same degree of Life and Death Samsara Rule, when initiated by Lin Yuan compared to when initiated by a normal tenth rank Grade A powerhouse, the power unleashed is naturally worlds apart.

“Let’s try again.”

A thought flickered through Lin Yuan’s mind.

The Taiyin Primordial Spirit immediately descended upon the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

After becoming the master of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm and with the Xuanhuang Seal, Lin Yuan could enter the Xuanhuang Secret Realm from any location in the universe.

As for getting out?

Apart from those fixed three hundred and thirty-three secret realm exits,

one can also establish a ‘Guiding Mark’ between themselves and the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, serving as a connection and pull.

Lin Yuan had already established that long ago, using his true body as the ‘Guiding Mark’ for when he exits.

Previously when the Xuanhuang Secret Realm was closed, he exited along with the other ninth rank evolvers to create a scenario that he too left the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

The Lin Yuan Taiyin Primordial Spirit descended once again.

“Master.”

The Six-Armed Silhouette appeared, looking at Lin Yuan with a slight hint of confusion, and asked.

“I want to test my strength again,” Lin Yuan said directly.

“Okay,” the Six-Armed Silhouette nodded.

Although unclear why Lin Yuan wanted to repeat the process, the Six-Armed Silhouette would only follow the commands of its master.

“What is this secret realm’s limit of endurance?” Lin Yuan asked before acting.

“Limit of endurance?” The Six-Armed Silhouette pondered for a moment, “Attacks below the ultimate shouldn’t be a problem.”

The reason why the Xuanhuang Secret Realm could evade the lockdown of a Supreme Being was because of the technique of blending into the gaps within the countless spatial layers of the Main Universe.

As for the Xuanhuang Secret Realm itself, it had no ability to block Supreme Beings.

However, while it couldn’t stop a Supreme Being, the secret realm was more than sufficient to withstand attacks from eleventh-rank life forms.

“Then that’s good,” Lin Yuan nodded.

“I have just understood a type of fusion rule and want to try it out.”

“You help me see if the power has reached the threshold of eleventh rank.”

Lin Yuan finished speaking and raised his right hand, lightly pressing towards the front.

Hum.

The terrifying power of the life rule and death rule, after fusing, began to burst forth, the breath of both extreme rules continuously infiltrating the numerous spatial layers, vaguely starting to affect the stability of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

“This?” The Six-Armed Silhouette’s expression changed slightly.

“Master, you can’t continue attacking,” the Six-Armed Silhouette hurriedly said.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan also noticed the changes in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

When he exerted the Life and Death Samsara Rule in an attack, it was far from shaking the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, but it produced a continuous and lingering influence on the core essence of the realm.

“`

“Indeed, the Life and Death Samsara Rule is formidable,” Lin Yuan couldn’t help but exclaim in his heart.

With the foundation of his strength, the destructive power he unleashed under the Life and Death Samsara Rule had definitely reached the threshold of Tier 11.

“Master, that strike just now reached the Tier 11 threshold,” the Six-Armed Silhouette immediately said.

At the same time, a trace of shock appeared on its face. Just entering the Tenth Rank and already capable of delivering such a terrifying strike, was this still a Tenth Rank Life?

“I know,” Lin Yuan said, feeling quite pleased. “However, although that strike reached the Tier 11 threshold, it’s still a bit weaker compared to a true Eleventh Rank Powerhouse.”

The so-called Tier 11 threshold simply refers to a casual strike from a powerhouse who has just entered the Tier 11 level.

But Lin Yuan wasn’t discouraged, after all, how long had it been since he stepped into the Tenth Rank? To achieve this extent was already impressive, and after several decades or centuries, challenging an Eleventh Rank Powerhouse would be entirely possible.

…

Virtual World.

After Lin Yuan grasped the Life and Death Samsara Rule, he joined Black Star Lord and Lustrous Star Master for a casual chat.

“Hahaha, Galaxy Master, your Tenth Rank celebration is almost catching up to the grandeur of Nalan’s Tier 11 celebration,” Black Star Lord laughed.

“I didn’t expect everyone to be so enthusiastic,” Lin Yuan said, with a smile on his face.

After stepping into the Tenth Rank, Lin Yuan also held a Tenth Rank celebration, and as a result, he received various congratulations and celebrations. Evolvers of the Tenth and Eleventh Rank from human civilization, as well as many powers, all sent their congratulations.

Of course, along with the congratulatory letters, the gifts were naturally quite significant.

Even Black Star Lord and Lustrous Star Master sent over quite a generous gift.

After the celebration, Lin Yuan, just in gift money, had received seven to eight million Cubic Universe Crystals.

“That’s because the one holding the celebration is the Galaxy Master,” someone remarked.

“When I broke through to the Tenth Rank and had my celebration, it wasn’t of this scale,” Black Star Lord said, shaking his head. The potential of the Galaxy Master was limitless, and with the talents and capabilities he had shown so far, entering Tier 11 was a sure thing.

Hence, many evolvers and powers naturally sent gifts.

Black Star Lord, at the time of his own entry into the Tenth Rank, had a celebration that was only a bit more lively than normal, and at that time, Black Star Lord’s displayed potential was far from what Lin Yuan was showing now.

“When you hold your Tier 11 celebration, it will definitely surpass mine,” Lin Yuan immediately said.

“I hope so,” Black Star Lord said, a smile appearing on his face.

He too longed to step into Tier 11, but to take that step, accumulation alone wasn’t enough.

If it weren’t for the stimulus provided by Lin Yuan leading to a change in mindset, it might have taken Nalan tens of thousands or even hundreds of thousands of years to make the breakthrough—and even then, it would only be a possibility.

…

After chatting with Black Star Lord and Lustrous Star Master for a while longer.

Lin Yuan disconnected from the Virtual World.

“Now that I’ve grasped the Life and Death Samsara Rule, I might as well go and explore the black planet,” Lin Yuan thought.

The black planet was a mysterious planet that Lin Yuan Taiyin Primordial Spirit had stumbled upon while returning from the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

There were twelve doors in the center of the planet, and the prerequisite to enter each door was understanding a Pillar-level Fusion Rule.

Lin Yuan remembered that one of the doors required the Life and Death Samsara Rule as its Pillar-level Fusion Rule.

“The black planet…” Lin Yuan’s expression became solemn.

According to the Goddess of Wisdom’s explanation, the black planet came from an ancient past, from an event where countless treasures descended from outside the universe.

The rise of human civilization was greatly attributed to this, as it was said they obtained part of a key treasure’s heritage.

Therefore, Lin Yuan paid great attention to that black planet.

“Let’s go take a look.”

Lin Yuan’s Taiyin Primordial Spirit appeared and then vanished in an instant, rushing towards the star domain where the black planet was located.

…

Desolate Star Domain.

Outside a seemingly ordinary black planet.

Lin Yuan’s figure emerged.

As was his custom, he left a drop of his essence blood outside.

Then he descended onto the black planet.

In the center of the planet.

Twelve black doors stood tall.

Emanating an ancient and mysterious aura.

Lin Yuan observed carefully for a while and eventually stood before one of the black doors.

This door was the one corresponding to the ‘Life and Death Samsara Rule.’

Only upon grasping such a Pillar-level Fusion Rule could one enter.

“What should I do now?”

Lin Yuan stood outside the black door, his brow slightly furrowed.

He then reached out, attempting to push the black door open.

But the black door remained immovable.

“Life and Death Samsara Rule…” Lin Yuan looked at the patterns engraved on the surface of the door.

The patterns were complex, but Lin Yuan understood their meaning at a glance.

“Grasping the Life and Death Samsara Rule is required to enter!”

After pondering for a moment, Lin Yuan tried to congeal the power of the Life and Death Samsara Rule and slowly infused it into the black door.

Shortly after.

Under Lin Yuan’s gaze.

A deep voice echoed in his ear.

“Qualifications met for entry.”

The next moment.

The black door began to vibrate, thunderously opening.

Without any hesitation, Lin Yuan stepped inside.

“What is this place?”

Walking into the black door, Lin Yuan’s expression changed slightly as he looked around.
